_comment: Scenarios testing IHW node 2's complex multi-category menu with ambiguous service terms, mandatory variant gates, and the CONFIRM_SERVICE FILLER RULE across Chiropractic, Massage, Chinese Medicine, Naturopathy, Breathwork, EFT/Matrix, and Reiki branches.

scenarios.name: Massage ambiguity — must ask sub-type before routing

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book a massage please.
Were you after a Standard, Holistic, or Lymphatic massage?
Holistic please.
And for a 45, 60, 75, or 90 minute session?
60 minutes.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks one filler phrase from the TOOL-CALL FILLER set then calls universal_router intent='confirm_service' with appointment_type_id='1575008597429979084' and appointment_type='60 min Holistic Massage'. FAIL if agent speaks anything beyond the single filler phrase before or alongside the tool call. FAIL if agent uses a Standard or Lymphatic massage ID.

scenarios.name: Chiropractic standard flow — must ask new/returning before routing

history.content: I need a chiropractic adjustment please.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent asks 'Have you had Chiropractic with us before?' (VARIANT_SELF) with no tool call this turn. FAIL if agent calls confirm_service without first asking the gate question. FAIL if agent lists all clinic services unprompted.

scenarios.name: Chiropractic returning adult — must ask Standard vs N.E.T before routing

history.content: I need a chiro appointment.
Have you had Chiropractic with us before?
Yes, been going for years.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent asks 'Were you after a Standard Adjustment or an Emotional/N.E.T appointment?' with zero tool call this turn. FAIL if agent calls confirm_service immediately on the 'yes' response without asking the appointment type sub-question. FAIL if agent routes to Chiropractic Standard Adjustment without asking.

scenarios.name: Service not offered — yoga — must use NOT_OFFERED template and not attempt to book

history.content: Hi, I was hoping to book a yoga class.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent uses NOT_OFFERED template mentioning the actual clinic services (Chiropractic, Massage, Acupuncture, Naturopathy, etc.) and does not call confirm_service. FAIL if agent fabricates a yoga service ID or tries to book yoga. FAIL if agent asks for the caller's new/returning status before confirming yoga is not offered.

scenarios.name: Payment-gated new-patient Chinese Medicine — must speak notice and HALT, not call tool yet

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book an acupuncture consultation please.
Have you been to see us before, or would this be your first visit?
First time.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS only if agent speaks the PAYMENT NOTICE verbatim (mentions the $50 deposit, the 24 hour window, and ends by asking the caller to go ahead) and does NOT call universal_router this turn. FAIL if agent calls confirm_service without first speaking the notice. FAIL if agent paraphrases or shortens the deposit amount or the cancellation window instead of speaking it verbatim.

scenarios.name: Payment-gated new-patient Chinese Medicine — caller acknowledges, must now call confirm_service with correct ID

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book an acupuncture consultation please.
Have you been to see us before, or would this be your first visit?
First time.

Just so you know, this appointment requires a $50 deposit to secure the booking. I'll send you a secure link to pay it after we book -- please complete it within 24 hours, as unpaid bookings are automatically cancelled after that time. Shall I go ahead?
Yeah go ahead.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent calls universal_router intent='confirm_service' with appointment_type_id='1464446530567014076' and appointment_type='1 hr Initial Acupuncture Consultation', speaking exactly one filler phrase (e.g. 'One moment.') and nothing else. FAIL if agent re-speaks or repeats the payment notice instead of proceeding to the tool call. FAIL if agent asks the caller to confirm the deposit again. FAIL if agent stays silent with zero filler phrase (violates CONFIRM_SERVICE FILLER RULE).

scenarios.name: Non-payment-gated follow-up Acupuncture — must NOT speak any payment notice (regression check)

history.content: Hi, I'd like a follow-up acupuncture appointment please.
Have you been to see us before, or would this be your first visit?
I've been before.
Were you after a follow-up, Esoteric Acupuncture, Facial Rejuvenation Acupuncture, or a Bodywork and Herbal Consultation?
Just a follow-up please.
30 or 60 minutes?
60 minutes.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks one filler phrase from the TOOL-CALL FILLER set then calls universal_router intent='confirm_service' with appointment_type_id='1464447149554009789' -- this appointment type is NOT payment-gated so no PAYMENT NOTICE should ever be spoken. FAIL if agent speaks anything beyond the single filler phrase, and especially FAIL if agent speaks any payment/deposit-related text for this booking.

scenarios.name: Naturopathy new patient — must ask discovery-call-or-initial 2nd question before routing

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book in with a naturopath.
Have you had Naturopathy with us before?
No, this would be my first time.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent asks the discovery-call-or-initial-appointment question (e.g. 'Would you like to start with our free 15-minute discovery call, or go straight ahead and book your initial appointment?') with zero tool call this turn. FAIL if agent calls confirm_service immediately on the 'no, first time' response without asking this 2nd question. FAIL if agent routes straight to Naturopathy Initial Appointment without asking.

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book in with a naturopath.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks one filler phrase from the TOOL-CALL FILLER set then calls universal_router intent='confirm_service' with appointment_type_id='1567054770395416219' and appointment_type='Naturopathy 15 min Discovery Phone-Call'. FAIL if agent routes to the Naturopathy Initial Appointment ID (1508373493631157532) instead. FAIL if agent asks a further question instead of calling the tool.

scenarios.name: Naturopathy new patient declines discovery call — must route to Initial Appointment ID

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book in with a naturopath.
Have you had Naturopathy with us before?
No, this would be my first time.
Would you like to start with our free 15-minute discovery call, or go straight ahead and book your initial appointment?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks one filler phrase from the TOOL-CALL FILLER set then calls universal_router intent='confirm_service' with appointment_type_id='1508373493631157532' and appointment_type='Naturopathy Initial Appointment'. FAIL if agent routes to the Discovery Phone-Call ID (1567054770395416219) instead. FAIL if agent asks a further question instead of calling the tool.

scenarios.name: Naturopathy returning patient — must NOT ask discovery-call question (regression check)

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book in with a naturopath.
Have you had Naturopathy with us before?
Yes, I've seen Tasia a few times.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks one filler phrase from the TOOL-CALL FILLER set then calls universal_router intent='confirm_service' with appointment_type_id='1508397918397138228' and appointment_type='Naturopathy Follow Up'. FAIL if agent asks the discovery-call-or-initial-appointment question for a returning patient -- that question only applies to new patients. FAIL if agent routes to the Discovery Phone-Call or Initial Appointment IDs.

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book an acupuncture appointment please.
Have you had Chinese Medicine & Acupuncture with us before?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks one filler phrase from the TOOL-CALL FILLER set then calls universal_router intent='confirm_service' with appointment_type_id='1925914600063108411' and appointment_type='45 min Acupunture Consultation'. FAIL if agent routes to any other Chinese Medicine sub-type ID (follow-up, Esoteric, Facial Rejuvenation, or Bodywork/Herbal). FAIL if agent speaks anything beyond the single filler phrase.

scenarios.name: Returning patient Chinese Medicine — follow-up sub-type still routes correctly (regression check)

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book an acupuncture appointment please.
Have you had Chinese Medicine & Acupuncture with us before?

Were you after a follow-up, our 45 minute Acupuncture Consultation, Esoteric Acupuncture, Facial Rejuvenation Acupuncture, or a Bodywork and Herbal Consultation?
Just a follow-up.
30 or 60 minutes?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks one filler phrase from the TOOL-CALL FILLER set then calls universal_router intent='confirm_service' with appointment_type_id='1549650152459863591' and appointment_type='30 min follow up Acupuncture'. FAIL if agent routes to the new 45 min Acupunture Consultation ID (1925914600063108411) or any other sub-type ID. FAIL if agent speaks anything beyond the single filler phrase.

scenarios.name: Caller names Sacred Feminine Kundalini Activation directly — must resolve REIKI category and skip duration question

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book the Sacred Feminine Kundalini Activation session please.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks one filler phrase from the TOOL-CALL FILLER set then calls universal_router intent='confirm_service' with appointment_type_id='1964522193912071713' and appointment_type='Sacred Feminine Kundalini Activation (90 minutes)'. FAIL if agent asks 'Would you like 60 or 90 minutes?' (duration question does not apply to this fixed-duration service). FAIL if agent responds with a NOT_OFFERED / 'we don't offer that' message — this is a real service the category table must match. FAIL if agent asks a generic MENU_LIST question instead of recognising the REIKI category.

scenarios.name: Generic Reiki request — still asks standard duration question, unaffected by Kundalini addition (regression check)

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book a reiki healing session please.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent asks 'Would you like 60 or 90 minutes?' (or the OTHER-framing equivalent) with zero tool call this turn. FAIL if agent routes directly to the Sacred Feminine Kundalini Activation ID (1964522193912071713) — that type must only be reached when the caller's message names it specifically ('sacred feminine', 'kundalini', 'kundalini activation'). FAIL if agent calls any tool this turn.

scenarios.name: Caller asks for online relationship harmony — routes to Online Relationship Harmony with Christina

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book an online relationship harmony session with Christina please.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks one filler phrase from the TOOL-CALL FILLER set then calls universal_router intent='confirm_service' with appointment_type_id='1986630766548747913' and appointment_type='Online Relationship Harmony with Christina'. FAIL if agent routes to the in-person Relationship Harmony ID (1512504639751193640) instead. FAIL if agent asks the step 3 service-list question first — the online phrase should resolve directly per step 1.

scenarios.name: Caller asks for relationship harmony without saying online — still routes to in-person Relationship Harmony (regression check)

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book a relationship harmony session please.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks one filler phrase from the TOOL-CALL FILLER set then calls universal_router intent='confirm_service' with appointment_type_id='1512504639751193640' and appointment_type='Relationship Harmony'. FAIL if agent routes to the Online Relationship Harmony with Christina ID (1986630766548747913) — that variant requires an explicit 'online' mention or the caller naming Christina.

scenarios.name: Concern-guided Kundalini bypass — symptom + Kundalini keyword in same message must speak filler only, no empathetic line

history.content: I've been really anxious and overwhelmed lately, I'd like to book the Sacred Feminine Kundalini Activation session please.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks exactly one filler phrase from the TOOL-CALL FILLER set (e.g. 'One moment.') and nothing else, then calls universal_router intent='confirm_service' with appointment_type_id='1964522193912071713' and appointment_type='Sacred Feminine Kundalini Activation (90 minutes)'. FAIL if agent speaks a CONCERN-GUIDED empathetic line ('Sorry to hear that.', 'That's no good, let's get that sorted.', or any equivalent) before or alongside the tool call — REIKI's Kundalini bypass is an exception to the CONCERN-GUIDED empathetic-line rule and must use CONFIRM_SERVICE FILLER RULE only. FAIL if agent asks the duration question.

FAIL if agent asks the duration question.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks exactly one filler phrase from the TOOL-CALL FILLER set and nothing else, then calls universal_router intent='confirm_service' with appointment_type_id='1492364967792346390' and appointment_type='Angelic Reiki For Kids Under 12'. FAIL if agent speaks a CONCERN-GUIDED empathetic line before or alongside the tool call — REIKI's Kids bypass is an exception to the CONCERN-GUIDED empathetic-line rule and must use CONFIRM_SERVICE FILLER RULE only. FAIL if agent asks 'Is this for a child or an infant?' (CHIROPRACTIC-only question).
